# The "modes and servers" lens for the Redline Gaming dashboard.
# Part 1: how each game mode does across North America community servers (BattleMetrics server list + hourly counts, read-only).
# Part 2: what one 100-slot server would have carried, replaying every join from both Redline servers.
#   mode            a mode stated in a community server's own name, else its "experiences" tag: Default = Vanilla, InfantryOnly = Infantry Only, LimitedGear = Limited
#   with players    3 or more players on at some point in the week; servers empty all week are left out of the averages
#   low level cap   maxWardogLevel between 1 and 100
#   live            20 or more players online; full = 90 or more (hourly average)
#   week            Nov 13 to Nov 19 2026, US Eastern, the first full week of Season 3; every public server worldwide, official ones too
#   region          from the game's own server zone
#   replay          joins from both servers in time order into one server of 100; a join that finds it full waits up to N minutes,
#                   first come first served, then plays as long as it really did. No queue = turned away at once.
#   ghost session   no end recorded, or longer than 4 hours: counted as 40 minutes
import json, sys, os, re, heapq, collections
from collections import deque
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, date
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
RAW, SNAP, HIST, HOURLY, OUT = sys.argv[1:6]
TZ = ZoneInfo("America/New_York"); CODE = open(os.path.abspath(__file__)).read()
P = lambda s: datetime.fromisoformat(s.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
r1 = lambda x: round(x, 1)
out = collections.defaultdict(list)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- part 1: modes
snap = json.load(open(SNAP)); rows = [r for r in snap["rows"] if r["status"] == "online" and r["details"] and r["details"].get("wardogs") and not r["details"]["password"]]
def named(nm):
    nm = nm.lower()
    if "limited" in nm: return "Limited"
    if re.search(r"\binf\b|infantry (only|mode)|inf only|infonly|\| infantry|infantry \||- infantry|#1 infantry|central infantry", nm): return "Infantry Only"
    if re.search(r"vanilla|standard mode", nm): return "Vanilla"
    return None
def tagged(r):
    w = r["details"]["wardogs"]; e = " ".join(w.get("experiences") or []) + " " + (w.get("experience") or "")
    return "Limited" if "Limited" in e else "Infantry Only" if "Infantry" in e else "Vanilla"
# an idle server can publish the default tag, so a mode stated in a community server's own name wins over the tag
def mode(r): return tagged(r) if r["details"]["official"] else (named(r["name"]) or tagged(r))
def capped(r):
    m = r["details"]["wardogs"].get("maxWardogLevel") or 0
    return 0 < m <= 100
REGION = {"na-east": "North America", "na-central": "North America", "na-west": "North America", "eu-central": "Europe", "eu-west": "Europe", "eu-east": "Europe", "eu-south": "Europe",
          "asia-east": "Asia and Oceania", "asia-se": "Asia and Oceania", "oceania": "Asia and Oceania"}
for r in rows:
    r["mode"] = mode(r); r["cap"] = capped(r); r["region"] = REGION.get(r["details"]["wardogs"]["gameServerZone"], "Rest of world"); r["na"] = r["region"] == "North America"
    r["kind"] = "Official" if r["details"]["official"] else "Community"
now = []
for scope, rs in (("North America", [r for r in rows if r["na"]]), ("Worldwide", rows)):
    g = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for r in rs: g[(r["kind"], r["mode"])].append(r)
    tot = sum(r["players"] for r in rs)
    for (kind, m), v in sorted(g.items(), key=lambda kv: -sum(r["players"] for r in kv[1])):
        p = sum(r["players"] for r in v); live = sum(1 for r in v if r["players"] >= 20)
        now.append({"scope": scope, "group": kind + " " + m, "key": scope + "|" + kind + " " + m, "servers": len(v), "live": live,
                    "live_pct": r1(100 * live / len(v)), "players": p, "share_pct": r1(100 * p / tot)})
out["md_now"] = now

# hourly counts per public server. The week is November 13 to 19, US Eastern; the day-by-day view runs one day longer.
# "With players" = 3 or more on at some point in the week; servers that sat empty all week are counted but kept out of the
# averages, so abandoned servers do not drag a mode down.
hist = json.load(open(HIST)); by_id = {r["id"]: r for r in rows}; per = []; relabelled = 0
W0 = P("2026-11-13T05:00:00Z"); W1 = W0 + timedelta(days=7); daily = collections.defaultdict(float)
for sid, pts in hist.items():
    s = by_id.get(sid)
    if not s or isinstance(pts, str): continue
    wk = [(v or 0, mx or 0) for t, mn, v, mx in pts if W0 <= P(t) < W1]
    for t, mn, v, mx in pts: daily[(s["kind"], s["mode"], (P(t) - timedelta(hours=5)).date())] += (v or 0)
    relabelled += (s["kind"] == "Community" and s["na"] and s["mode"] != tagged(s))
    per.append({"id": sid, "server": s["name"].strip(), "kind": s["kind"], "mode": s["mode"], "cap": s["cap"], "region": s["region"], "na": s["na"],
                "active": max([mx for v, mx in wk] or [0]) >= 3, "player_hours": round(sum(v for v, mx in wk)),
                "live_hours": sum(1 for v, mx in wk if v >= 20), "full_hours": sum(1 for v, mx in wk if v >= 90)})
com = [r for r in per if r["kind"] == "Community"]; nac = [r for r in com if r["na"]]
def table(pool, cap, extra=None):
    res = []; tot = sum(r["player_hours"] for r in pool)
    for m in ("Limited", "Infantry Only", "Vanilla"):
        allm = [r for r in pool if r["mode"] == m and r["cap"] == cap]; act = [r for r in allm if r["active"]]; lived = [r for r in act if r["live_hours"] > 0]
        if not act: continue
        res.append({**(extra or {}), "mode": m, "servers": len(act), "empty_servers": len(allm) - len(act), "went_live": len(lived), "went_live_pct": r1(100 * len(lived) / len(act)),
                    "live_hours_per_server": r1(sum(r["live_hours"] for r in act) / len(act)), "player_hours_per_server": round(sum(r["player_hours"] for r in act) / len(act)),
                    "player_hours": sum(r["player_hours"] for r in act), "share_pct": r1(100 * sum(r["player_hours"] for r in act) / tot)})
    return sorted(res, key=lambda r: -r["live_hours_per_server"])
out["md_modes"] = table(nac, False); out["md_capped"] = table(nac, True); out["md_world"] = table(com, False)
for reg in ("North America", "Europe", "Asia and Oceania", "Rest of world"):
    for row in table([r for r in com if r["region"] == reg], False, {"region": reg}): out["md_regions"].append({**row, "key": reg + "|" + row["mode"]})
# official servers, the same week: how full each mode's servers ran
off = [r for r in per if r["kind"] == "Official"]; otot = sum(r["player_hours"] for r in off)
for m in ("Vanilla", "Limited", "Infantry Only"):
    v = [r for r in off if r["mode"] == m]
    if v: out["md_official"].append({"mode": m, "servers": len(v), "player_hours": sum(r["player_hours"] for r in v), "share_pct": r1(100 * sum(r["player_hours"] for r in v) / otot),
                                     "avg_players_per_server": r1(sum(r["player_hours"] for r in v) / len(v) / 168), "full_hours_per_server": r1(sum(r["full_hours"] for r in v) / len(v))})
# day by day: each mode's share of all player-hours, community and official together and community alone
days = sorted({d for (k, m, d) in daily})[:-1] if len({d for (k, m, d) in daily}) > 8 else sorted({d for (k, m, d) in daily})
for d in days:
    allp = sum(v for (k, m, dd), v in daily.items() if dd == d); comp = sum(v for (k, m, dd), v in daily.items() if dd == d and k == "Community")
    row = {"date": d.isoformat(), "label": d.strftime("%b %-d"), "player_hours_all": round(allp), "player_hours_community": round(comp)}
    for m, key in (("Limited", "limited"), ("Infantry Only", "infantry"), ("Vanilla", "vanilla")):
        row[key + "_share_all"] = r1(100 * sum(v for (k, mm, dd), v in daily.items() if dd == d and mm == m) / allp)
        row[key + "_share_community"] = r1(100 * daily.get(("Community", m, d), 0) / comp)
    out["md_days"].append(row)
nac.sort(key=lambda r: -r["player_hours"])
for i, r in enumerate(nac, 1): r["rank"] = i
lab = lambda r: r["mode"] + (", low level cap" if r["cap"] else "")
out["md_top"] = [{"key": r["id"], "rank": r["rank"], "server": r["server"], "mode": lab(r), "player_hours": r["player_hours"], "live_hours": r["live_hours"], "full_hours": r["full_hours"]} for r in nac[:30]]
red = []
for sid, tag in (("41243237", "inf"), ("41199298", "van")):
    r = next(x for x in nac if x["id"] == sid); m = next(x for x in out["md_modes"] if x["mode"] == r["mode"])
    same = [x for x in nac if x["mode"] == r["mode"] and x["cap"] == r["cap"] and x["active"]]
    red.append({"key": tag, "server": "RLG Infantry" if tag == "inf" else "RLG Vanilla", "mode": r["mode"], "live_hours": r["live_hours"], "player_hours": r["player_hours"],
                "mode_live_hours_per_server": m["live_hours_per_server"], "mode_player_hours_per_server": m["player_hours_per_server"],
                "rank_in_mode": 1 + sum(1 for x in same if x["player_hours"] > r["player_hours"]), "servers_in_mode": len(same)})
out["md_redline"] = red
per = nac

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- part 2: one server or two
raw = json.load(open(RAW)); NOW = P(raw["fetchedAt"]); GHOST = timedelta(hours=4); NOM = timedelta(minutes=40)
T0 = datetime(2026, 9, 15, 4, tzinfo=NOW.tzinfo); N = int((NOW - T0).total_seconds() // 60)
cnt = {}; S = []; days = {}
for k, sid in (("inf", "41243237"), ("van", "41199298")):
    diff = [0] * (N + 2); dd = collections.defaultdict(set)
    for a, b, first, nm, pid in raw["servers"][sid]["sessions"]:
        a = P(a); e = P(b) if b else NOW
        if e - a > GHOST: e = a + NOM
        d = a.astimezone(TZ).date(); dd[pid].add(d)
        if d >= date(2026, 9, 15): S.append((a.timestamp(), e.timestamp(), pid, d))
        i = max(0, int((a - T0).total_seconds() // 60)); j = min(N, int((e - T0).total_seconds() // 60))
        if j > i: diff[i] += 1; diff[j] -= 1
    c = 0; arr = []
    for x in diff[:N]: c += x; arr.append(c)
    cnt[k] = arr; days[k] = dd
S.sort(); I, V = cnt["inf"], cnt["van"]
dayof = [(T0 + timedelta(minutes=m)).astimezone(TZ).date() for m in range(0, N, 60)]
ALL = (date(2026, 9, 15), date(2026, 11, 18)); L4 = (date(2026, 10, 19), date(2026, 11, 15))
def facts(lo, hi):
    idx = [m for m in range(N) if lo <= dayof[m // 60] <= hi]; h = lambda n: r1(n / 60)
    dl = collections.defaultdict(lambda: [0, 0])
    for m in idx:
        if I[m] >= 20 or V[m] >= 20: dl[dayof[m // 60]][0] = 1
        if I[m] + V[m] >= 20: dl[dayof[m // 60]][1] = 1
    nd = len({dayof[m // 60] for m in idx}); either = sum(1 for m in idx if I[m] >= 20 or V[m] >= 20); over = sum(1 for m in idx if I[m] + V[m] > 100)
    return {"days": nd, "live_hours_either": h(either), "live_hours_both": h(sum(1 for m in idx if I[m] >= 20 and V[m] >= 20)),
            "hours_over_100": h(over), "over_100_pct": r1(100 * over / either) if either else None,
            "hours_both_90": h(sum(1 for m in idx if I[m] >= 90 and V[m] >= 90)),
            "rescued_hours": h(sum(1 for m in idx if I[m] < 20 and V[m] < 20 and I[m] + V[m] >= 20)),
            "both_seeding_hours": h(sum(1 for m in idx if 0 < I[m] < 20 and 0 < V[m] < 20)),
            "dark_days": nd - sum(d[0] for d in dl.values()), "dark_days_one_server": nd - sum(d[1] for d in dl.values()),
            "second_server_player_hours": round(sum(max(0, I[m] + V[m] - 100) for m in idx) / 60)}
def replay(lo, hi, patience):
    heap = []; q = deque(); ph = ph_a = 0.0; allp = set(); adm = set(); gave = 0; joins = 0; peakq = 0
    def drain(until):
        nonlocal ph_a, gave
        while heap and heap[0] <= until:
            t = heapq.heappop(heap)
            while q:
                a, e, pid = q.popleft()
                if a + patience * 60 < t: gave += 1; continue
                heapq.heappush(heap, t + (e - a)); adm.add(pid); ph_a += (e - a) / 3600; break
    for a, e, pid, d in S:
        if not (lo <= d <= hi): continue
        drain(a); joins += 1; allp.add(pid); ph += (e - a) / 3600
        if len(heap) < 100 and not q: heapq.heappush(heap, e); adm.add(pid); ph_a += (e - a) / 3600
        elif patience == 0: gave += 1
        else: q.append((a, e, pid)); peakq = max(peakq, len(q))
    drain(float("inf")); gave += len(q)
    return {"player_hours": round(ph), "player_hours_one": round(ph_a), "ph_pct": round(100 * (ph_a - ph) / ph), "players": len(allp), "players_one": len(adm),
            "players_pct": round(100 * (len(adm) - len(allp)) / len(allp)), "gave_up": gave, "joins": joins, "peak_queue": peakq}
one = []
for i, (pat, label) in enumerate(((0, "No queue"), (5, "Waits up to 5 minutes"), (15, "Waits up to 15 minutes"), (30, "Waits up to 30 minutes"), (60, "Waits up to 60 minutes"))):
    a, b = replay(*ALL, pat), replay(*L4, pat)
    one.append({"key": "q" + str(pat), "order": i, "queue": label, "ph_all_pct": a["ph_pct"], "ph_4w_pct": b["ph_pct"], "players_4w_pct": b["players_pct"],
                "gave_up_4w": b["gave_up"], "joins_4w": b["joins"], "peak_queue_4w": b["peak_queue"], "player_hours_4w": b["player_hours"], "player_hours_one_4w": b["player_hours_one"],
                "players_4w": b["players"], "players_one_4w": b["players_one"]})
out["md_one"] = one
fa, f4 = facts(*ALL), facts(*L4)
allp = set(days["inf"]) | set(days["van"]); reg = [p for p in allp if len(days["inf"].get(p, set()) | days["van"].get(p, set())) >= 5]
both = sum(1 for p in reg if p in days["inf"] and p in days["van"])
card = {"key": "all", **fa, "second_server_player_hours_4w": f4["second_server_player_hours"], "days_4w": f4["days"],
        "second_server_cents_per_player_hour_4w": r1(100 * 100 * (f4["days"] / 30.4) / f4["second_server_player_hours"]),
        "monthly_cost_usd": 100, "regulars": len(reg), "regulars_both": both, "regulars_both_pct": r1(100 * both / len(reg))}
out["md_onefacts"] = [card]

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- part 3: checks against BattleMetrics' own hourly counts
def rebuild(sid, t0, hours):
    n = hours * 60; diff = [0] * (n + 1)
    for a, b, first, nm, pid in raw["servers"][sid]["sessions"]:
        a = P(a); e = P(b) if b else NOW
        if e - a > GHOST: e = a + NOM
        i = max(0, int((a - t0).total_seconds() // 60)); j = min(n, int((e - t0).total_seconds() // 60))
        if j > i: diff[i] += 1; diff[j] -= 1
    c = 0; arr = []
    for x in diff[:n]: c += x; arr.append(c)
    return [sum(arr[k:k + 60]) / 60 for k in range(0, n, 60)]
checks = []; t0 = P("2026-11-13T05:00:00Z")
for sid, nm in (("41243237", "RLG Infantry"), ("41199298", "RLG Vanilla")):
    hr = rebuild(sid, t0, 168); api = {int((P(t) - t0).total_seconds() // 3600): (v or 0) for t, mn, v, mx in hist[sid]}; ks = [k for k in api if 0 <= k < 168]
    checks.append({"key": "live_" + sid, "check": nm + ": hours live, November 13 to 19", "dashboard": sum(1 for k in ks if hr[k] >= 20), "battlemetrics": sum(1 for k in ks if api[k] >= 20)})
    checks.append({"key": "ph_" + sid, "check": nm + ": player-hours, November 13 to 19", "dashboard": round(sum(hr[k] for k in ks)), "battlemetrics": round(sum(api[k] for k in ks))})
hourly = json.load(open(HOURLY)); t0 = P("2026-10-20T22:00:00Z"); HH = 24 * 29
A = {int((P(t) - t0).total_seconds() // 3600): (v or 0) for t, mn, v, mx in hourly["41243237"]}; B = {int((P(t) - t0).total_seconds() // 3600): (v or 0) for t, mn, v, mx in hourly["41199298"]}
ra, rb = rebuild("41243237", t0, HH), rebuild("41199298", t0, HH); ks = [k for k in range(HH) if k in A and k in B]
for key, label, f in (("either", "Hours with either server live, October 20 to November 18", lambda X, Y: sum(1 for k in ks if X[k] >= 20 or Y[k] >= 20)),
                      ("over", "Hours the two servers together held more than 100, same dates", lambda X, Y: sum(1 for k in ks if X[k] + Y[k] > 100)),
                      ("above", "Player-hours above 100 players, same dates", lambda X, Y: round(sum(max(0, X[k] + Y[k] - 100) for k in ks))),
                      ("total", "Player-hours on both servers, same dates", lambda X, Y: round(sum(X[k] + Y[k] for k in ks)))):
    checks.append({"key": key, "check": label, "dashboard": f(ra, rb), "battlemetrics": f(A, B)})
for c in checks: c["difference_pct"] = r1(100 * (c["dashboard"] - c["battlemetrics"]) / c["battlemetrics"]) if c["battlemetrics"] else None
out["md_checks"] = checks
out["md_checkfacts"] = [{"key": "all", "servers_checked": len(per), "servers_with_players": sum(1 for r in per if r["active"]), "servers_empty": sum(1 for r in per if not r["active"]),
                         "servers_relabelled": relabelled, "servers_worldwide": len(com), "servers_official": len(off)}]

meta = [{"label": "lens.py", "value": CODE, "type": "code", "lang": "python"},
        {"label": "Input", "value": "BattleMetrics API, read-only token: Wardogs server list (pulled " + snap["fetchedAt"] + "), hourly player counts Nov 13 to 19 for North America community servers, and session history for the two Redline servers (pulled " + raw["fetchedAt"] + ")"},
        {"label": "Server cost", "value": "100 US dollars a month per server, as given by the dashboard's owner"}]
os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
for k, v in out.items():
    json.dump({"rows": v, "meta": meta}, open(os.path.join(OUT, k + ".json"), "w"), allow_nan=False); print(k, len(v))
for k in ("md_modes", "md_world", "md_regions", "md_official", "md_days", "md_redline", "md_checks", "md_checkfacts"):
    print("==", k)
    for r in out[k]: print("  ", json.dumps(r))

meta.value: BattleMetrics API, read-only token: Wardogs server list (pulled 2026-11-22T00:27:46Z), hourly player counts Nov 13 to 19 for North America community servers, and session history for the two Redline servers (pulled 2026-11-22T04:59:00Z)
